parameters.content:
##  Supplier Capacity Risk Alert Workflow

## How it works:
This workflow runs automatically at a scheduled time and continuously monitors supplier performance. It fetches real-time supplier data such as total orders, delivered quantity, and delay metrics. Using predefined thresholds, it calculates key metrics like fulfillment rate and overall risk score. AI is then used to refine the risk classification (Low, Medium, High) and provide a reason with confidence. If a supplier is identified as high risk, the workflow generates actionable mitigation steps and also suggests backup suppliers to reduce dependency. These results are then combined and sent as alerts via Email and Slack to the procurement team. Finally, all outcomes—whether high, medium, or low risk—are logged into Google Sheets to maintain a complete audit trail and support future decision-making.
## Setup steps:
Configure threshold values (risk score, fulfillment rate, delay) in the Initialize Risk Config node.
Replace mock API URLs with your actual supplier data source or ERP system.
Connect Groq/OpenAI credentials for AI-based risk classification and action generation.
Set up Gmail node with proper authentication to send email alerts.
Configure Slack node by selecting the correct workspace and channel.
Connect Google Sheets and map columns for logging supplier risk data.
Verify schedule trigger timing and timezone as per business requirement.
Test the workflow with sample data to ensure all nodes work correctly before deployment.

## Data Preparation
Fetches supplier data, applies thresholds, validates input, and converts it into structured format for risk analysis.

## Risk Calculation & AI Classification
Calculates fulfillment rate, delay, and overall risk score based on defined thresholds. AI then refines the risk level and provides a clear classification with reason. If AI fails, the system safely falls back to rule-based results.

## High Risk Processing
Triggers only for high-risk suppliers. Generates mitigation actions and fetches backup suppliers, then combines results. It focuses on immediate risk reduction by suggesting practical steps like adjusting order allocation, expediting deliveries, or temporarily shifting to alternative vendors. The system ensures that recommendations are specific to the supplier’s performance issues, making them actionable within a short time frame. This stage helps decision-makers quickly respond to risks instead of just identifying them.

## Alerts & Logging
Sends notifications for high-risk suppliers through email and Slack with all key details and recommendations. All results, including high, medium, and low risk, are stored in Google Sheets for tracking. This helps maintain a complete history of supplier performance. It also ensures better monitoring and future decision-making.

## Schedule Trigger
Runs workflow automatically at scheduled time
